mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month indicates economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% year-over-year signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS MoM < -0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it indicates a weak economy with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when UNRATE > 6% and FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST MoM > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) is growing at a rate of more than 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising, it indicates strong economic growth with tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances when INDPRO YoY > 3% and FEDFUNDS rising.
